links.outcome: Faithfulness, context recall, answer relevance of RAG-grounded chatbot; manual comparison with other models
links.effect: Context recall 95%, faithfulness to source 93.73%, answer relevance 92.28%; manual assessment showed GastroBot delivered more valuable knowledge with completeness and consistency than other models.
links.quote: During manual assessment of GastroBot, in comparison with other models, our GastroBot model delivers a substantial amount of valuable knowledge while ensuring the completeness and consistency of the results.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning the embedding model on domain guidelines (25 GI guidelines) to improve retrieval hit rate (18% over base gte-base-zh, 20% over OpenAI Embedding)

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks GastroBot, a Chinese gastroenterology chatbot using RAG, evaluating its performance via RAGAS automated metrics and manual assessment without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
